text.vignette: Forest corners you at the supply shelf with a hopeful grin and an outstretched hand, because he knows about the bottle you found. He has been a thorn in everybody's side for weeks, but the red suit does make the children laugh.

options.give-him-the-bottle: Forest takes the bottle and stumbles off to ring a bell outside the Grocery Store: he is placed there (not a move) and 4 noise tokens are added at the Grocery Store.
options.tell-him-no: Forest lashes out at someone weaker: the survivor with the lowest influence (not counting Forest) takes 1 wound.
